description: Find customer domains with observed technology transition signals involving a specified vendor and return prioritized signals with supporting evidence. USE WHEN: an agent needs to identify customer-level technology transition signals related to a vendor for prospecting or change analysis. DO NOT USE WHEN: the agent needs confirmed proof that a customer switched from one vendor to another (`vendor_customer_confirmed_lookup`), historical ADDED/REMOVED adoption events (`vendor_customer_adoption_change_lookup`), or vendors currently detected on a specific customer domain (`customer_vendor_detection`); POSSIBLE_REPLACEMENT is a correlated signal, not a confirmed switch. Side effect: unsupported-vendor requests may persist aggregated demand telemetry. Results reflect CSI snapshots and may change between calls.

vendor.description: Vendor whose customer technology transition signals should be evaluated. Supported values: yotpo, judge.me.
